name: chat-input
useFor: Use under a conversation. Pass `placeholder`, `site` (a SiteChip), `textareaProps` for the value and an `onSubmit`. `submitDisabled` disables Ask and Enter while the question is empty; `loading` keeps Enter from sending while the agent answers; `compact` makes Ask the chip's height.
constraints: A send icon in place of Ask
A composer taller than its question
title: Chat input
description: The composer: a text area that grows with the question, the site chip and Ask, in the large cut frame.
